lines:
Implemented the value-carrying control-node contract.

Delivered: (1) portKindsConnect now treats flow/route as control semantics that carry the incoming value, so flow -> text and route -> text are valid while text -> route stays invalid; approval and parallel ports are relabelled (Value / Carried value) and condition/parallel/approval descriptions state the pass-through. (2) The condition node's default predicate was corrected from the runtime-unknown {op:"always"} to {kind:"always"}, and the predicate form now reads and writes the runtime's `kind` vocabulary (with `op` still read as a legacy alias so old documents stay editable). The flat form now offers only the kinds it can fully author (always/exists/eq/neq); nested and/or/not remain accepted by the validator for hand-authored JSON. (3) Native side: validate_v1_executable_catalog never checked port kinds, so no validator change was needed; a new documents.rs test proves the native catalog accepts a graph where an approval gate and a routed condition both feed an Agent (editor-clean == runtime-executable). (4) Runtime guarantee made directly testable: the value selection was extracted into the pure `carried_value` helper used by incoming_value, documenting and testing that a value crosses an active transition unchanged, that a skipped branch contributes nothing, and that an active transition from an unexecuted source yields nothing. Approval denial keeps the existing failed-outcome path and therefore produces no successor value.

Tests: graph_pass 11/11 (new control_values_cross_active_edges_and_skipped_branches_contribute_nothing); documents catalog_rejects_unknown_nodes_cycles_bad_conditions_and_bad_configs incl. the new value-carrying acceptance; frontend nodeCatalog 10/10 (new value-carrying graph asserts both validateWorkflow and assessNativeWorkflow agree) and NodeConfigurationForm 2/2; tsc --noEmit clean.

No changes to freeze, authority, no-replay, or the node-type set. NOTE: the flat predicate form intentionally no longer offers and/or/not because it cannot author their required operands; they stay valid in JSON and are evaluated by the frozen runtime.

Remove the typed-port limitation that stops control constructs from gating or routing a text pipeline.

Problem. In the shipped v1 catalog, approval and parallel expose only flow ports and condition only route ports, while agent, model_call, tool, output and wait consume only text. The editor's portKindsConnect rejects flow -> text and route -> text, so an approval node or a routed branch can never feed a model node, even though the runtime already carries a value through these nodes via incoming_value. The result is that any gated or conditional model workflow is editor-invalid and Save-blocked, which is why DSH-style plan approval and conditional routing cannot be authored today.

Design fit. Treat flow/route as control semantics rather than an incompatible data type, and give control nodes a declared typed pass-through value.
- Extend the node catalog and port model: approval and parallel accept the incoming value and emit it unchanged on their control output; condition accepts text and emits the incoming value on both the true and false routes. Unknown or skipped branches produce no value.
- Update the editor validator (validateWorkflow, portKindsConnect, nodeCatalog) and the native executable validator (validate_v1_executable_catalog) and assessNativeWorkflow together, so editor-clean and runtime-executable stay equivalent; add contract tests that assert this equivalence in both directions.
- Runtime guarantees: a value crosses at most one node identity and lands on the successor through a new immutable context revision with provenance; a skipped branch contributes nothing; an approval denial keeps the existing failed-outcome contract and never invents a value.
- Keep the frozen-graph, authority, freeze and no-replay invariants untouched. No new authority and no new node type.

This unblocks the plan-review gate and conditional routing into model/tool nodes as pure contract corrections.

Outputs. Catalog and port-contract change; runtime pass-through and skip semantics with provenance; editor handle rendering and properties help; contract tests for approval pass-through, condition route value selection, skipped-branch behavior, denial semantics, and editor/runtime validation equivalence.

data.title: Let approval, condition, and parallel nodes carry values into model nodes
